name: Dionaea no Enshoku
source:
Two young men meet in a strange library. One is "Chisei," an investigator of this bizarre world, and the other is a mysterious young man (?) who lives there.
That encounter reawakens memories and emotions they thought they had buried, and the shadow of that day begins to cast a pall over their peaceful lives—.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/15049]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
两名青年在一座诡异的图书馆中相遇。一人是调查这个异常世界的调查员“知诚”，另一人则是居住在此地的神秘青年（？）。
这场邂逅唤醒了本以为早已尘封的记忆与情感，那一日的阴影也随之悄然笼罩了他们平静的生活——

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/15049]Novelgame[/url]]
